dina: PR #7042 — onprem doc fixes: add SUSE wicked note, HSM pin caching guidance, and an airgap cert-rotation checklist. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7042

ravi: quick skim: looks good. please don't hardcode /usr/lib paths for pkcs11; add a small detection snippet for common locations.

claire: adding a short systemd tmpfile example for transient PIN files and a note about permission 0600. will push shortly.

infra-max: I'll validate wicked commands on SLES 15 and add a fallback for systems without nc (use bash /dev/tcp). also add firewall small matrix: egress 443 required.

docs-bot: preview live: https://deploy.preview/docs/pull/7042 CI: docs-build passed (sles/amd64).

dina: assigning reviewers: ravi + infra-max. aim to merge after tiny edits today. post-merge: update TOC and changelog (docs-only).

claire: pushed commit that includes pkcs11 detection snippet and tmpfile sample (commit ghi789).

ravi: LGTM, left one nit about wording around 'open ports' -> changed to 'required egress'.

infra-max: validated wicked snippet in SLES container, confirmed pkcs11 package is opensc on SLES. no further issues.

dina: thanks — merging once approvals are in. will ping #customer-success after merge.

dina: closing thread.
